description: The chats this account has heard from, newest first, with chat_id and whether each is a person, a group or a LINE room. LINE lists none itself, so a chat is known only once it has written. -- MakeHybrid API plan, GET /line/v1/connections/{connection_id}/chats, group line.

connection_id.description: Value for the {connection_id} segment of /line/v1/connections/{connection_id}/chats. Required; pass it raw (it is URL-escaped for you).

query.description: Optional query-string parameters, e.g. {"limit":"20","cursor":"..."}. Values are coerced to strings.
